concerns.text: FR-001 mandates fetching data from BOTH Materials Project and AFLOWlib. Task T012b (AFLOW ingest) is marked '[ ]' (unimplemented) and T012c (validation/merge) is marked '[ ]' (unimplemented). The plan requires both sources for SC-001 coverage. Without these tasks, the system cannot satisfy FR-001 or SC-001.

Plan mandates LOEO cross-validation to satisfy Constitution Principle VII. Task T014b (generate element_groups.json) and T021 (execute LOEO split) are marked '[ ]' (unimplemented). T020 (train) depends on T021. Without these tasks, the core modeling strategy (LOEO) is missing, violating the Plan and Constitution Principle VII.

SC-003 requires a warning if physical violation rate > 5%. Task T028b mentions logging a warning if rate > 5% but does not explicitly include a task to 'calculate the aggregate violation rate percentage' from the residuals before logging. The logic to compute the rate is missing from the task description, creating a gap in satisfying SC-003.

US-2 Acceptance 1 requires the system to 'complete within 1 hour'. Task T037 only logs a warning if runtime > 1 hour. There is no task to enforce the hard constraint (e.g., raise an error or fail the run) if the limit is exceeded, leaving the acceptance criteria unmet.

Task T012a contains an unresolved claim marker '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_b856c987 — status=not_enough_info]'. This is a stale or incomplete artifact tag that should be resolved or removed to ensure the task is actionable.
